title: Zero-fuel docked watch: a scout already docked at Frontier Station (Altais, the Outer Rim capital) saves its order book and mission board every 5 minutes for 30 minutes
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-25 11:25 UTC. The form of watch-book-node-beta (zero-fuel docked watch, market_poll every 5 minutes for 30 minutes, one ship a station, only a scout already in the system). Orders ENT-093, block ORACLE: scouts born elsewhere work their own region (F35); the Outer Rim rows end at home-frontier-station, and a scout docked there with no census due takes this watch instead of a census leg into another empire's region. The capital's book and its ship listings feed Trade and the upgrade service.
